run_interdistinct_on_conversations: run the script to compute inter-distinct n-gram metrics on TOD conversation JSONL files
compute_interdistinct_metric: compute the InterDistinctMetric for a given utterance text and n-gram size
setup_args_parser: setup the ParlaiParser with a required path argument for conversation files
parse_conversation_turns: parse dialog turns from JSONL conversation files and extract user and system utterances
output_interdistinct_csv: output comma-separated inter-distinct n-gram values for user and system utterances per file
